risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate downward trend (a net fall of ~43% of its level). Seasonality is strong (period 48): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (944 points, ~3% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.399), which favours a weighted combination.
